chapter.heading: A song for pilgrims ascending to Jerusalem. A psalm of David.
Psalm 133
chapter.v:
How wonderful
and pleasant it iswhen brothers live together in harmony!

For harmony
is as precious as the anointing oilthat was poured over Aaron’s head,that ran down his beardand onto the border of his robe.

Harmony is
as refreshing as the dew from Mount Hermonthat falls on the mountains of Zion.And there the Lord has pronounced his blessing,even life everlasting.
